column7:
Augmentation in provision of
`19.99 lakh was the neteffect
of increase of ` 55.57 lakh
and decrease by re-
appropriation of ` 35.58
lakh. Increase of ` 19.99 lakh
was attributed to need of
additional amounts to
purchase of new van in
Motor van item for use of
the Legal Adviser-cum-
Secretary. Increase of ` 35.58
lakh was attributed to need of
additional amounts in pay,
subsistence allowance, rent
allowance, transport
allowance, medical
allowance, other allowance,
office expenditure and
contract services to Legal
Adviser and Counsel in
financial year 2022-23.
Decrease by re-appropriation
of ₹ 35.58 lakh was attributed
to anticipated saving.
Reasons for final saving have
not been intimated (August
2023).
